_rule: Atlas v2.1 commissioning bars, SEALED 2026-10-14 before the v2.1 atlas exists (readiness L15). Drafted 2026-10-12 in DEV_ATLAS_COMMISSION_01.md; fixed here with the details the draft left open. Test data are the plan's held-out assignments (atlas_v21_plan.md, 'Held-out assignments by use'), purified healthy cells from laboratories that share no GEO contributor with any build source (rule 9). No held-out array is opened before this file and the atlas both exist. Scorers: commission_v21.py; planted test: planted_commission_v21.py. A use that is not commissioned is labeled development everywhere it appears.

U1_reference_profiles.interval: posterior predictive 90 % interval for one new sample from a new laboratory (offset 0), from the 100 saved draws of mu and of the donor spread with 20 noise samples per draw, by the fit's own likelihood (commission_v21.predictive_interval)
U1_reference_profiles.coverage: per held-out sample, share of its measured sites inside the interval; per set, the mean over its samples
U1_reference_profiles.bar: 0.80 <= coverage <= 0.97 for every independent set of the cell on that platform
U1_reference_profiles.verdict: per cell and platform: COMMISSIONED, FAILED, or NOT ASSESSED (no independent set). Reported by cell and by sample.
U1_reference_profiles.sets: atlas_v21_plan.md U1 list (GSE184269, the GSE224807 held-out half, GSE59065, GSE87640, GSE87095, GSE131989 after its UCSF check, the smaller sets listed there; sequencing GSE173787)

U2_blind_sites.what: the composition-blind sites of each sealed tissue test. U2a: the exact sealed site lists the cancer results used (sites_methylated + sites_unmethylated in each sealed file). U2b: the same rule re-applied to the v2.1 atlas (that test's panel, tolerance, epithelial SD <= 0.05 and value windows, 3,000 per channel).

lung.anchor: mean of the two lung epithelia

U2_blind_sites.measure: for each panel cell type with an independent held-out set of at least 3 arrays: the set's mean at each blind site against the atlas anchor value; share within the test's tolerance
U2_blind_sites.bar: share >= 0.90 for every assessed panel cell
U2_blind_sites.verdict: per tissue, for U2a and U2b separately: COMMISSIONED if the epithelium is assessed and every assessed panel cell meets the bar; FAILED; or NOT ASSESSED. Panel cells with no independent set are listed.
U2_blind_sites.sets: atlas_v21_plan.md U2 list (colon epithelium held-out half of E-MTAB-4957; lung bronchus GSE104471, GSE85566, GSE201872; alveolar macrophages GSE132547 after its D13 check) and the U1 immune sets

U3_composition.bars: DEV_ATLAS_COMMISSION_01.md bars 1-2, unchanged: neutrophil fraction mean absolute error <= 0.02 and every sample within 0.05 on each independent truth set (>= 2 sets, >= 20 samples); not worse than the current method on neutrophils on any independent set. Bar 3 (every group RMSE <= 0.03) is a later commissioning.
U3_composition.sets: GSE127824 (24 cord bloods, FACS counts); GSE167202 (provisional: ED patients, custom EPIC); GSE122126 is from the Dor laboratory and is reported, not counted (rule 9)
U3_composition.tool: the v2.1 composition step built exactly as atlas_e was from v2, on the v2.1 means

U4_identity_sites: stays development, no bar (v2 FAILED B1 and B2, PROC-V12-IDENTITY-02); not used by any commissioned reading
same_cell_different_laboratory: reported, not a bar: for every cell with two or more independent sets, the share of sites where the set means differ by less than their combined 90 % interval
carried_preconditions: D13 (GSE132547 purity and laboratory check) and D14 (GSE131989 UCSF check) must be recorded before those sets are scored (l8_conditions_v21.md)
